Petition Till Realization.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT 1.
This appeal is by the Insurer challenging the fastening of liability on it.
2. The appeal was filed on the ground that the driver of the offending vehicle did not possess requisite endorsement to drive the vehicle.

In the light of the judgment rendered by the Apex Court in the case of Mukund Dewangan Vs. Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd - (2017)14 SCC 663, the ground raised in this appeal would not survive for consideration.
